source_basis: Owner Battles, Weapons, Armies & Production Design Bible
authority_rule: Film chronology and outcomes remain immutable. Visual staging, optional traversal texture and encounter pressure may enrich presentation but cannot create alternate canon outcomes.
global_rules: Prefer chapter-specific silhouette, lighting, atmosphere and landmark composition before raw prop count.
Keep hero vistas readable in foreground/midground/background layers.
Use short story-beat camera moments only at major landmarks; do not turn every transition into a cutscene.
Use production meshes when present and retain deterministic fallbacks.
Measure target-device cost before raising asset density or texture resolution.
Watcher, Balrog and Lurtz are film-locked presentation threats; gameplay cannot rewrite their required outcomes.
Primary routes must remain readable through landmark framing, architecture, light and terrain before UI direction.
Every explorable branch must serve story, preparation/resource, relationship/lore or meaningful traversal.
Mission logic owns state; cinematic and camera systems only present already-authoritative state.
Battle scalability keeps full AI inside the hero bubble and avoids adding unnecessary full-simulation background combatants.

camera_execution.strategy: Short spring-arm/FOV framing treatments on selected landmark/threat cues; no full Sequencer dependency and no camera cue may own story progression.
performance_rules: Reuse the existing player spring arm and follow camera.
No new scene-capture target, cinematic camera actor, post-process stack or tick-heavy camera manager.
Treatments blend back automatically after a bounded duration.
camera_execution.acceptance_boundary: This is runtime camera framing, not final film-grade camera/Sequencer acceptance.

threat_material_palettes.runtime_rule: Production threat/hero meshes keep authored OBJ/MTL materials; engine BasicShape tint applies only to fallback primitives.

world_rules: iconic silhouette first, gameplay readability second, micro-detail third
companion and traversal safety remains stronger than decoration
battle_rules: full AI remains bounded to the hero bubble
mission_rules: logic owns state and cinematics present state

current_wave.acceptance_rule: Do not promote to visual/device acceptance from headless automation alone.
